q: When should I plant maize in Ejura?
pre_sent: Thank you. Your question was sent to an extension officer for review. You will get the answer here.
draft:
To plant maize in Ejura, consider the following:

1. **Planting Window**: The major season transition period is either from mid-March to end of April [MOFA-MAIZE:p11-transition-major] or from end of March to end of April [IITA-MAIZE-2025:p16-transition-major]. The minor season transition period is either from mid-July through August to early September [MOFA-MAIZE:p12-transition-minor] or from mid-July to early September [IITA-MAIZE-2025:p16-transition-minor]. The officer should choose which applies.

2. **Planting Time**: Plant after three good rains within the planting window to ensure enough soil moisture [IITA-MAIZE-2025:p15-three-good-rains]. Sow after the rains have stabilized to avoid wilting [MOFA-MAIZE:p10-when-to-plant].

3. **Rainfall Record**: From 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24, there were 24 of 30 days with at least 1 mm of rain, totaling 185.5 mm [RAINFALL-OPEN-METEO:ejura:2026-10-25]. The officer should decide if this meets the guides' conditions.

Note: (officer only) Question received 25 Oct 2026. Windows cited: MoFA major season, transition: Mid-March-end of April; IITA major season, transition: End of March - End of April; MoFA minor season, transition: Mid July through August-early Sept.; IITA minor season, transition: Mid of July - Early September. The date is outside the cited windows.
Note: (officer only) District Ejura/Sekyedumase taken from the question text.
